text:
anya: Heads-up — we just saw a +7% jump in fncall validator rejects in us-west2 starting 15:42 UTC. Top reason shows BAD_TOOL_SHAPE / unexpected array for `attributes`.
pablo: I saw the spike on my alert page. Is this tied to last night's strict-validator rollout?
kevin: Canary was pushed to 5% in us-west2 at 15:30. It added stricter shape checks for the `attributes` field on several tool hooks.
ops: We've got a handful of customer 400s. Willing to flip soft-validate for affected shards if we confirm a regression.
anya: Sample reject (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool": "user_features",
  "resp": {
    "id": "u_123",
    "attributes": []
  },
  "req_id": "r_user_77"
}
```
Validator expects `attributes` to be a map/object; some adapters still return [] in the empty-case.
pablo: That adapter normalization was supposed to be part of the legacy-adapter cleanup. Looks like one code-path missed the patch.
kevin: I'll push a small coercion in the adapter shim: coerce null|[]|"" -> {} before sending to validator. Unit test included. ETA ~12m.
anya: Console/UX ask: can we add an "interlock" toggle on the rollout page that prevents auto-fallback unless audit logging is enabled? Ops wants a trail when an automated fallback changes routing.
ops: Strong yes on the interlock. We had an incident where auto-fallback hid a downstream data-shape regression and we couldn't trace who flipped things. Audit trail + reason required.
kevin: Also a routing question: if we auto-fallback to permissive route, which quota bucket gets billed? The permissive route uses different model variants; we need to ensure the cost attribution and quota usage are correct.
anya: Good catch — currently routing changes don't rewrite quota labels. We should emit a `routing.fallback_reason` tag and route attribution label so billing shows whether a request was served by permissive variant due to validator fallback.
pablo: Telemetry additions: emit span tags `validator.mode`, `validator.canary_pct`, and `routing.fallback` (true|false). Add metric counters: `fncall.validator.rejects_total` (labels: region, tenant, validator_mode) and `fncall.validator.fallbacks_auto_total` (labels: region, tenant).
ops: For debugging, request a permissioned "unmasked-sample" link on the reject row that pulls the original payload into a secure store. RBAC to SRE+Platform only, with an automatic scrub review note. Retention 7 days.
kevin: We'll need to add a small sampling throttle so we don't leak too many raw samples. Proposal: capture 0.5% of hard rejects full-unmasked and 5% of soft-validations. Both go to secure bucket.
anya: UX: the rollout page should show a new panel: "Validator health" with rejects pct, canary pct, and an action button to `enable-auto-fallback` which will be disabled until audit-logging is on (the interlock). The enable flow should show estimated cost delta and p50 latency delta.
pablo: On cost delta, we can compute expected token+model cost by sampling the last 1h of requests for that slice and using model-case profiles. Display a conservative range.
kevin: Also we should add a lightweight "preflight check" that simulates the coercion on a 5k-sample of recent payloads and surfaces how many would change shape. That helps decide whether to enable auto-fallback or just patch adapters.
anya: Decision items: 1) kevin pushes adapter coercion patch (in progress). 2) ops to enable soft-validate for affected shards until patch lands. 3) product/console: add interlock+audit toggle and a validator health panel. 4) infra/telemetry: add tags and metrics described above + sample retention policy.
ops: Enabling soft-validate for shard s-west-12 now. Creating incident #5219 and watching error budget.
kevin: Patch pushed, CI green, cutting release now. Will post when adapters are live.
pablo: I'll start a tiny UX ticket for the interlock (require audit logging ON to toggle auto-fallback) and the health panel layout.
anya: After patch lands let's run a 10m health window and require rejects <0.5% before reverting soft-validate. Also confirm routing attribution labels show up in billing logs.
ops: Noted. I'll add billing team to the incident so we can validate quota attribution.
console-bot: deploybot: strict-validator canary enabled in us-west2 at 15:30 UTC by kevin
console-bot: opsbot: incident #5219 created and assigned to eng-platform
